name: 4315.webp
description: A woman in a shimmering metallic gold bodysuit stands centrally in a cosmic seascape, surrounded by multiple melting golden clocks, two large golden hands emerging from water in the foreground, glowing jellyfish, elephants on stilts, and a futuristic city under a swirling starry nebula sky with floating eyeballs and bare trees.
title: Surreal Melting Dreamscape
prompt: Surreal dreamlike scene of a beautiful woman with elaborate updo standing waist-deep in dark water, wearing a tight metallic gold snakeskin-patterned bodysuit. Multiple oversized ornate golden melting clocks drip from bare tree branches and stone platforms. Two giant golden human hands rise from the water in foreground. Bioluminescent blue and pink jellyfish float in the water. Stilt-walking elephants in the distance. Futuristic cyberpunk city with glowing billboards on the right. Cosmic swirling nebula sky in deep blues, purples, oranges with floating eyeballs and stars. Dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed symbolic surrealism in the style of Salvador Dali and digital art
